title: Update to 3.5 breaks existing code when input value binding is an object

labels.name: :exclamation: p4-important
labels.description: Priority 4: this fixes bugs that violate documented behavior, or significantly improves perf.

body:
### Vue version v3.5.0 ### Link to minimal reproduction https://play.vuejs.org/# ### Steps to reproduce (note: this is a snippet and not actual code. May have syntax issues) ```js //actual related code ( look at the reproduceable example above for better understanding) const tiers = [ { label: "Production", value: "production" }, { label: "Staging", value: "internals" }, { label: "Test", value: "test" }, ]; const app = createApp({ data() { return { tiers: tiers, activeTiers: [], } } }); ``` ```html {{JSON.stringify(activeTiers)}}
``` ### What is expected? `activeTiers` is an array of selected checkbox values ( objects from `tiers` array). This was working upto `v3.4`. ### What is actually happening? ``` Uncaught TypeError: raw.map is not a function at reactiveReadArray (vue@3:1035:41) at vue@3:1048:28 at Array.map () at Proxy.concat (vue@3:1048:17) at HTMLInputElement. (vue@3:11832:31) ``` ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1a616e99-2199-4fe1-bf70-9916fc066b7e) ### System Info ```shell Vue version: v3.5 imported as: `` System: OS: Linux 5.15 Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS (Focal Fossa) CPU: (20) x64 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900HK Memory: 34.97 GB / 39.17 GB Container: Yes Shell: 5.0.17 - /bin/bash Binaries: Node: 20.15.0 - /usr/bin/node npm: 10.7.0 - /usr/bin/npm ``` ### Any additional comments? If we pin the vue import back to v3.4 this works just fine. Reproduction : Breaks ( v3.5): [ vue playground](https://play.vuejs.org/#) Works: (v.3.4) [vue playground](https://play.vuejs.org/#)
